newsitem.title: CHINA: Bank of China pledges 8 bln yuan in H2 loans.
newsitem.headline: Bank of China pledges 8 bln yuan in H2 loans.

text.p: The Bank of China will extend eight billion yuan in loans to large-scale state-owned enterprises in the second half of 1996, the China News Service said on Monday.
The bank had already given 4.5 billion yuan in loans for operating capital to state enterprises in the first six months of this year, the newspaper said.
This year the bank would continue to give priority to loans for the development of large-scale state-owned enterprises, it quoted Wang Xuebing, president of the Bank of China as saying.
